events.title: Russia-Ukraine war: strikes on Zaporizhzhia, Odesa and Kyiv
events.place: Kyiv, Zaporizhzhia, Odesa region and nationwide
events.summary: A Russian air attack on Zaporizhzhia at dawn on 24 November killed two people and wounded more than 40. Late on 24 November further attacks killed two people, including a child, in Odesa region, and a drone hit beside a 16-storey residential building in Kyiv, injuring two.
events.advice: Anyone in Ukraine should follow air-raid alerts and plan for power and water outages. Avoid non-essential travel.

events.title: US-Iran confrontation: strikes, blockade and shortages
events.summary: A US missile strike hit Qeshm Island on 20 November and Iran began electricity rationing on 22 November. Iran said on 23 November it would use all tools against the US naval blockade, in place again since 14 July, and its forces struck Bahrain on 21 November (see separate entry). The US ambassador to Israel said on 24 November that military action could resume if diplomacy fails.
events.advice: Avoid travel to Iran. Staff in Gulf countries should watch for airspace closures and follow embassy guidance.

events.title: Bahrain: Iranian missile and drone strikes
events.summary: Bahrain said an Iranian attack on 21 November hit a civilian industrial site on Sitra Island, wounding two people, one critically. Iran's Revolutionary Guards said they targeted US air defence systems at two bases. Iranian strikes on Bahrain resumed on 13 November after a lull since early September.
events.advice: Staff and travellers in Bahrain should follow civil defence alerts, know their nearest shelter and expect possible flight disruption.

events.title: Gaza and West Bank: continued strikes, meningitis alert in Gaza
events.summary: Israeli strikes on 24 November killed at least seven people in Gaza, including a child and police officers, according to health officials. Gaza's health ministry counts 1,679 people killed since the October 2025 ceasefire and has issued an epidemic alert for meningitis, with 272 cases in October against a usual 30 to 50 a month.
events.advice: Avoid travel to Gaza and the West Bank. Staff in Israel should follow Home Front Command instructions.

events.title: Lebanon: Israeli strikes continue despite truce
events.summary: Lebanese media reported Israeli strikes and blasts in several southern villages on 24 November, after strikes on the Beqaa Valley on 19 November. Lebanon's Health Ministry counts 4,390 people killed between 2 March and 5 November. Talks between Israel and Lebanon are continuing.
events.advice: Avoid southern and eastern Lebanon. Staff in Beirut should keep travel documents ready and follow embassy alerts.

events.title: Yemen: renewed fighting and worsening humanitarian emergency
events.summary: Hostilities resumed in August, with fighting on the western coast and in southern Taiz. About 18.3 million people face acute food insecurity, and WHO recorded 674 deaths and 2,998 injuries between 6 August and 18 September.
events.advice: Avoid all travel to Yemen. Red Sea shipping and flights in the area may be disrupted.
events.source: Center for Disaster Philanthropy, weekly update 23 Nov

events.title: Sudan: drone attacks on Khartoum
events.summary: Drone attacks on Khartoum were reported on 23 November and condemned by the UN and the US. Sudan alleges the drones were launched from Ethiopia, adding to regional tension in a civil war now in its fourth year.
events.advice: Avoid all travel to Sudan.

events.title: Eastern DR Congo: mass displacement in South Kivu
events.summary: More than 320,000 people were displaced in South Kivu in a single week in early November, and over 7 million are displaced nationwide. Fighting in Ituri is also disrupting the Ebola response.
events.advice: Avoid travel to eastern DR Congo. See the separate Ebola entry for health precautions.

events.title: Sahel: jihadist attacks in Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger
events.summary: Conflict data for 7 to 13 November show an escalation by JNIM and the FLA in Mali, roadside bombs on a national route in Burkina Faso, and attacks in Niger that displaced thousands in Kirtachi.
events.advice: Avoid travel outside capital cities and follow embassy guidance in Bamako, Ouagadougou and Niamey.

events.title: Haiti: heavy fighting in Port-au-Prince
events.summary: On 19 November armed forces launched an operation to retake the Martissant corridor from gangs, the first major push there in five years; police said at least 34 suspected gang members were killed. Around 2,500 Salvadoran troops are also deployed, and the use of explosive drones is reported to be killing a growing number of civilians.
events.advice: Avoid travel to Haiti. Flights to Port-au-Prince can be suspended at short notice.

events.title: South Sudan: pre-election risk and humanitarian need
events.summary: A warning issued on 10 November flags risks ahead of elections scheduled for 22 December. About 10 million people need aid, with drought in Eastern Equatoria and flooding in Upper Nile.
events.advice: Reconsider travel around the 22 December vote.

events.title: Ethiopia: Tigray violence and tension with Eritrea
events.summary: Amnesty International said artillery strikes by Ethiopian forces and allied militia on urban areas of Tigray this year should be investigated as possible war crimes, and accused the TPLF of endangering civilians in fighting for Alamata in September, according to a 24 November roundup. Crisis Group earlier reported that relations between Addis Ababa and Asmara worsened sharply in October.
events.advice: Avoid travel to Tigray and monitor before travelling elsewhere in northern Ethiopia. No change for Addis Ababa at this stage.

events.title: Libya: Russian warship sunk at Benghazi
events.summary: Ukrainian naval drones sank a Russian warship at Benghazi on 22 November and also targeted a cargo vessel, extending the Russia-Ukraine war into the Mediterranean.
events.advice: Avoid the Benghazi port area. Maritime traffic in the central Mediterranean may see added security measures.

events.title: France: public-service strike called for 1 December
events.summary: Eight public-service union federations called on 20 November for a national strike and demonstrations on Tuesday 1 December over pay and the 2027 budget, the fourth such day this autumn after 5 and 17 November. As of 24 November no specific SNCF, RATP or air traffic strike was confirmed; operators publish forecasts the evening before. Marches are also planned in Paris on Saturday 28 November.
events.advice: Check SNCF and RATP forecasts from the evening of 30 November and avoid demonstration routes. Allow remote work where commuting is affected.

events.title: Cuba: energy collapse and shortages
events.summary: Cuba faces a humanitarian and energy crisis following US oil import restrictions in place since January. A seventh nationwide blackout on 18 September affected about 9.4 million people.
events.advice: Expect power, fuel and connectivity outages. Travellers should carry essentials and confirm accommodation has backup power.

events.title: Ebola (Bundibugyo virus) outbreak, international health emergency
events.place: Ituri, North Kivu and six other provinces
events.summary: Declared on 15 May. As of 17 November DR Congo had 11,504 confirmed cases and 5,630 deaths across 8 provinces, most of them in Ituri (7,911 cases) and North Kivu (2,925). Kenya has reported 9 cases with none new since 19 October, and Uganda's outbreak was declared over on 27 August. Africa CDC said on 15 November that the outbreak was still not under control.
events.advice: Avoid travel to affected provinces. Anyone returning from eastern DR Congo or with exposure risk should follow national health authority screening rules.
events.source: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control, update of 19 Nov

events.title: Florida: largest dengue outbreak in decades
events.summary: Florida recorded 524 locally acquired dengue cases through 31 October, against 62 in all of 2025, with at least one death. Three counties have declared local emergencies, and current flooding may add mosquito breeding sites.
events.advice: Staff in Florida should use repellent and remove standing water around homes.
events.source: Center for Disaster Philanthropy, weekly update 23 Nov

events.title: Florida: record flooding on the St. Johns River
events.summary: After days of torrential rain the St. Johns River reached a record 18.68 feet, above the 1953 record. Roads are cut, rescues and evacuations are under way, and major flooding could last into December.
events.advice: Staff in affected counties should follow local evacuation orders and avoid driving through floodwater.
events.source: Center for Disaster Philanthropy, weekly update 23 Nov

events.title: US East Coast: Thanksgiving storm with high winds and coastal flooding
events.place: Florida to New England (map position approximate)
events.summary: A storm is forecast to bring heavy rain, strong winds and coastal flooding from Florida and the Carolinas on 25 November to the Mid-Atlantic and Northeast on Thanksgiving Day, 26 November. Gusts up to 60 mph are possible in New York City and Philadelphia, with major flooding forecast in Charleston and moderate to major coastal flooding from Virginia to New York.
events.advice: Staff travelling for Thanksgiving should expect flight and road delays, check carriers before leaving and avoid flooded coastal roads.

events.title: Bali: floods and landslides
events.summary: Flooding that began on 22 November has killed at least two people, with one child missing. Landslides, fallen trees and building damage are reported and crews are pumping water from roads, schools and homes.
events.advice: Travellers should check road conditions and avoid river valleys and steep slopes during heavy rain.
events.source: Center for Disaster Philanthropy, weekly update 23 Nov

events.title: Indonesia: flooding in West Kalimantan and Sumatra
events.summary: Flooding since 19 November has affected about 28,900 people and 11,100 homes across seven districts of West Kalimantan, with more flooding across Sumatra. GDACS lists an active flood alert for Indonesia.
events.advice: Expect road closures and local travel delays.

events.title: Thailand: prolonged flooding in central provinces
events.place: Ayutthaya, Suphan Buri, Lop Buri, Nakhon Pathom, Chumphon; Phatthalung
events.summary: As of 15 November about 121,400 people were still affected by floods that began in September, with 89 deaths recorded. The update for 16 to 22 November also reports flooding in southern Phatthalung as the northeast monsoon starts.
events.advice: Bangkok is not listed as affected. Check routes before travelling north or south of the capital.

events.title: Malaysia: floods and landslides in five states
events.place: Selangor, Perak, Pahang, Negeri Sembilan, Melaka
events.summary: Authorities report flooding and landslides across five states at the start of the monsoon season. No casualty figures are given in the source.
events.advice: Watch local weather warnings, especially for road travel outside Kuala Lumpur.

events.title: California: king tides and coastal flooding
events.summary: One to three feet of coastal inundation is expected along most of the California coastline this week, with tides that may set records.
events.advice: Minor impact. Avoid low-lying coastal roads and car parks at high tide.

events.title: Cyclone Akvan: landfall in Odisha, now weakened
events.place: Gopalpur, Odisha and north Andhra Pradesh
events.summary: Cyclone Akvan came ashore near Gopalpur on 20 November with sustained winds of 70 to 80 km/h. More than 300,000 people were evacuated in Odisha and the storm weakened after landfall.
events.advice: Residual flooding and transport delays are possible in coastal Odisha and Andhra Pradesh.

events.title: M7.2 earthquake in the Banda Sea
events.summary: A magnitude 7.2 earthquake about 125 km deep struck the Banda Sea on 21 November, with shaking felt in Maluku, Tanimbar and Dili. It follows another strong quake in the same area on 16 November.
events.advice: No major damage is reported in the source. Staff in eastern Indonesia and Timor-Leste should expect aftershocks.

events.title: M6.5 earthquake near Vanuatu
events.summary: A magnitude 6.5 earthquake struck on 23 November at a depth of about 600 km. No tsunami warning was issued and no casualties were immediately reported.
events.advice: No action needed.

events.title: M6.4 earthquake in the Mauritius-Réunion region
events.summary: GDACS lists a magnitude 6.4 earthquake at 10 km depth in the Mauritius-Réunion region on 24 November at 11:06 UTC. The overall alert level is green, meaning low expected humanitarian impact.
events.advice: No action needed unless local authorities issue warnings.

events.title: Nigeria: large wildfires
events.place: Location not specified in alert (map position approximate)
events.summary: GDACS lists two forest fires in Nigeria updated on 24 November, covering about 48,000 and 14,700 hectares.
events.advice: Seasonal fires. Smoke may affect air quality locally.
